info.name: Gemini GMX v2.1 (HID)
info.author: Miss (original), community update
info.description: Native HID mapping for the Gemini GMX: hot cues, auto loops, loop rolls, sampler and FX pad modes, manual loops with jog adjustment, sync lock, pitch range, vinyl/CD jog modes, LED, VU meter and LCD feedback. Recommended over the MIDI mapping. Requires Mixxx 2.3.0 or newer.
